name: MICA 2026 cryo-EM benchmark
description: Dataset for a benchmark of MICA, ModelAngelo, EModelX(+AF), CryoAtom and EMProt on 24 cryo-EM maps and experimental reference structures first released in EMDB and PDB in 2026. CryoZeta is reported separately, including incomplete runs identified as partial outputs. Contains input sequences, reference structures, 214 scored model files with SHA-256 manifest, evaluation results and run records. Maps are available from EMDB under the listed accessions. Code, report, method versions and AI-tool assistance disclosure: https://github.com/MayFairMI6/mica-2026-cryoem-benchmark.
